sn45.56:1.1: RĀGAVINAYA. Suriyassa bhikkhave udayato- || pe || yad idaṃ kalyāṇamittatā || || Kalyāṇamittassetaṃ bhikkhave- || pe || bahulīkarissati || || Kathañ ca bhikkhave || pe || maggam bahulīkaroti || || Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti rāgavinayapariyosānaṃ dosavinayapariyosānam mohavinayapariyosānam || la || sammāsamādhim bhāveti rāga- dosa- mohavinayapariyosānaṃ || || Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāveti a- a- maggam bahulīkarotī ti
